title: CartDeliveryGroupMethod - Data API
description: Represents the selected delivery method for a cart delivery group used in Lightning B2B Commerce checkout. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

AdjustedShippingFee.description: Shipping fee, including TotalAdjustmentAmount, for the delivery method.

Carrier.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
Carrier.description: The carrier that the buyer chose for their delivery method. Values are defined based on the user’s shipping service. This field is available in API version 59.0 or later.

CartCheckoutSessionId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CartCheckoutSessionId.description: The unique ID used to identify your cart checkout session.

CartDeliveryGroupId.description: The ID of the cart delivery group associated with the checkout session.

ClassOfService.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ClassOfService.description: The carrier class of service that the buyer chose for their delivery method. Values are defined based on the user’s shipping service. This field is available in API version 59.0 or later.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The currency used for your shipping fee. Default value is USD. Possible values are: USD—U.S. Dollar

DeliveryMethodId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DeliveryMethodId.description: The ID of the selected order delivery method.

ExternalProvider.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ExternalProvider.description: The ID of the external shipping method provider. Optional field.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Assign new delivery groups to active delivery methods. The default value is False. This field is available in API version 59.0 or later.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update

ProcessTime.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProcessTime.description: Merchant-specified process time for the delivery method. Process time includes the time between when an order is placed and when the shipment is given to the shipping carrier.

ProcessTimeUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
ProcessTimeUnit.description: Unit of time used to define ProcessTime. Possible values are: Days Hours Weeks

ProductId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ProductId.description: Optional. This product represents a delivery charge order product for a delivery using this delivery method. For example, you could create a product that represents an overnight express charge and assign it to an overnight express delivery method. If your store uses Salesforce Native Shipping, the ProductId is selected from a non-variation product with Shipping in its name. The term Shipping in a product name isn’t localized. If no matching product is found, a random non-variation product is used. This field is available in API version 59.0 or later.

ReferenceNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ReferenceNumber.description: Reference number for an external delivery method. This field is available in API version 59.0 or later.

ShippingFee.description: Shipping fee associated with the delivery method. Required field.

TotalAdjustmentAmount.description: The adjustment amount of a promotion applicable to the delivery method.

TransitTimeMax.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TransitTimeMax.description: Maximum estimate of transit time for the delivery method. Transit time includes the time between when a shipping carrier receives a shipment and when the shipment arrives at the delivery address.

TransitTimeMin.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
TransitTimeMin.description: Minimum estimate of transit time for the delivery method. Transit time includes the time between when a shipping carrier receives a shipment and when the shipment arrives at the delivery address.

TransitTimeUnit.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TransitTimeUnit.description: Unit of time used to define TransitTimeMax and TransitTimeMin. Possible values are: Days Hours Weeks

WebCartId.description: The ID of the WebCart associated with the cart delivery group method. Required field.

special_access_rules: The CartDeliveryGroupMethod object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.
usage: Use the CartDeliveryGroupMethod object to give commerce buyers the ability to choose a delivery method for a cart delivery group. Shipping integrations populate the delivery options that are available for a cart delivery group.
